Auxiliary Administrative Procedures Course – Student Study Guide REVIEW QUESTIONS (Continued) CHAPTER 2 1. Today, the four cornerstones of the Auxiliary are defined as follows: 2. What activities are included in Member Services? 3. What activities are included in Recreational Boating Safety? 4. What activities are included in Operations and Marine Safety? 5. Which of the following programs is NOT authorized for Auxiliary sponsorship? a. administrative support of the Coast Guard b. bridge administration c. Sea Explorers d. port safety and security 6. An Auxiliarist while on a support mission, augmenting a Coast Guard unit, shall not participate in any law enforcement duties nor carry, handle, repair, or fire weapons of any sort. (TRUE/FALSE). 7. Naval Sea Cadets may not be given public education courses taught by the Auxiliary. (TRUE/FALSE) 8. Qualified Auxiliarists are authorized assignment to duty as military recruiters to support the Coast Guard’s recruiting program. (TRUE/FALSE) 2-1 Revised 1 March 2007
